description: NDW, the Dutch national road traffic data portal, holds estimates of daily traffic intensities for the entire Dutch road network, bought for the national road safety taskforce because traffic intensity is a key factor in crash risk. The estimates are made by Hastig from TomTom probe data (as seen in TomTom Move), adjusted for differing probe coverage by road type. Coverage: all roads in the Netherlands for 2022, 2023 and 2025; each year is linked to the National Road Database (NWB) of 1 January of the following year. Format and access: because of purchase conditions the set is not open data; road authorities, or third parties working for them, can request it through a link on the page. Licence and cost: restricted, on request. Caveats: NDW is not the source holder; the values are modelled from probes, not counted. For authorities that obtain it, the set gives link volumes on minor roads that counts miss, useful for network flow and road safety models. It relates to the NDW open data portal in the catalogue.
